notes.title: Christmas update!
notes.content:
It's Christmas season, let's celebrate by enjoying a new Christmas skin in Sep's Diner restaurants! 

Sep's Diner, Sep's Donut and even the pumpkins and bats of the Halloween foodtruck have put on their Christmas outfits!

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content: Fixed startup issue and total score display bug in leaderboard

notes.title: Halloween update! New restaurant!
notes.content:
[b]The spookiest of days is upon us! [/b]

This year, Halloween brings a new restaurant to Sep's Diner! And quite a few bats as well!

Enjoy the brand new food truck and cook some delicious kebabs for your hungry customers!

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content: Fixed bug where objects would stop spawning during very long infinite-mode plays

notes.title: Unicorn avatar and small bug fixes
notes.content: Added a unicorn avatar and corrected small bug fixes.

notes.title: Smaller Kitchen!
notes.content:
[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Smaller kitchen
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Stability fixes for multiplayer
[*] Improvement of teleport
[*] Minor bug fixes ingame
[/list]

notes.title: NEW MODES UPDATE
notes.content:
Christmas is coming, but it seems like Santa has already come... Enjoy 2 [b]new game-modes and a navigation update[/b]!

[list]
[*]Enjoy Sep's Diner in its "Relaxed" mode, without any timer. You can take as much time as you need to satisfy your customers!
[*]Let your imagination and creativity run free in the "Studio" mode. You can cook the meal you want, the craziest or the highest burger... Take a screenshot and share your creation on your favorite social media!
[*]New joystick navigation, as many asked for: left for 6-axis translation, right for rotation.
[/list]

Happy Holidays!
